text:
violet: noticed a rare dupe where the preflight notice and the seal event both get processed during broker churn, leading to duplicate ledger rows.

marc: what's preflight notice in this flow? our current pipeline emits a preflight then a seal; both flow to billing topics.

hannah: preflight is our inflight marker that dashboards consume. problem is some SDKs republish preflight on retry with new ids so dedupe by preflight_id fails.

violet: idea: switch to a single outward "seal_event.v2" that is canonical for accounting. keep preflight as a strictly-local sidecar signal for realtime UX. Seal contains an audit_stamp: a tiny HMAC-based tuple [hmac_tenant, short_req_hash, short_result_hash] truncated to 8 bytes each.

marc: HMAC with tenant key is interesting - makes dedupe stable across retries even if client spoof ids. How expensive is HMAC per request?

hannah: cheap at 64-bit truncated HMAC-SHA256 via hardware-accelerated library. worth it for correctness.

opsbot: branch metering/seal-v2 created. CI green.

violet: migration: run 10-day mirror-mode where we publish both legacy preflight+seal and seal_event.v2 with header x-metering-seal-mirror:true; consumers opt-in. After 10d flip to seal_event.v2 only with per-tenant feature flag.

marc: include a dedupe_token = hex(trunc_hmac(tenant_key, req_id || result_hash)) so ledger upserts by (dedupe_token, replay_tag). replay_tag in {live, repair, backfill}.

hannah: for backfills include original_job_id and original_ts. ledger will treat backfills idempotently when replay_tag=backfill and original_job_id matches.

violet: dashboards use sidecar /internal/metering/pending_count; prometheus scrapes it. we'll add a push on graceful shutdown to flush pending to metrics-agent for resilience.

marc: tests: wrote tools/sim_seal.py --scenario broker-churn --seed 31415 --runs 20k to exercise the race. will add invariants: no duplicate ledger write for same dedupe_token within 14 days.

hannah: bytes impact: audit_stamp ~24-32 bytes. at 120M events/month ~3.6GB extra per month. acceptable.

opsbot: canary scheduled for staging in 30m.

violet: audit tooling: prefer audit_stamp to reconstruct provenance; if missing, fallback to archived preflight payloads on s3. update replay tool to request full payload by original_job_id when necessary.

marc: add kafka header x-metering-version: seal-v2 so downstream can detect new schema. also publish migration guide and a compatibility topic for 30 days.

hannah: alerts: add panel for dedupe_collision_rate and pending_count_delta; set alert at 0.005% during mirror.

violet: I'll draft RFC follow-up with full schema examples, sim outputs, rollout plan, rollback steps, and canary checklist. pinging @marc @hannah for review.

billing-ops: LGTM from ops side. Keep an eye on refunds during mirror.

marc: thanks all, :thumbsup:
